tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs pa'i bum pa'i cho ga nyams grib mthar byed bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ nyam thag 'gro la rab brtse bas/ /skyon bral khro mo'i skur bstan nas/ /mi gtsang dri ma kun sel ma/ /mkha' 'gro sme brtsegs la btud nas/ /snyigs dus gdug can dar ba'i dus/ /'gro kun bag med kyis gos pa'i/ /nyams grib mi gtsang sbyang ba'i phyir/ /sme ba brtsegs pa'i khrus chog 'dri/ /'dir gru spang rtse ba rdo rje seng ge la mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyis gnang ba'i khro mo sme brtsegs kyi khrus chog la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ stegs bu gtsang mar padma 'dab brgyad rdul tshon nam/ ras dkar la bris pa'i steng du bum pa mgul chings dang bcas pa'i nang du bum snying nyer lnga chu gtsang dang bcas pa kha rgyan can gyi steng du/ dung chos dri bzang gis gang ba gzungs rdor dang bcas pa'i mthar/ mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga dang bum pa'i mdun du zlum gtor gcig gzhan yang rdo rje dril bu me tog sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog sogs nas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ zhes pa nas shapta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i snying rjes kun nas blangs te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro bas/ sems bskyed kyi tshig spyi 'gre la/ mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/

/zhes dang / tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs ma sku mdog sol ba ltar nag pa/ skyon cis kyang 'gos mi btub pa phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol ba'i dag byed kyi bum pa chus bkang ba bsnams te/ nyams grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad 'khrud par mdzad pa/ gcer bu rgyan spangs shing pad nyi'i gdan la zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i sku can du gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ khar khar/ dzirkha bi ma la se/ utstshuṣma kro dhī hūm̐ phaṭa swāhāḥ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa bzlas te/ mi gtsang ba'i nyes pa gang gis kyang mi gos par bsam mo/ /gal te mdze pho dang / yugs sa dang / mi dong po dang / dam nyams dang / tshul khrims 'chal ba dang / dme can dang / 'khon can la sogs pa dang 'grogs dgos pa byung na skad cig las lhar bsam ste bzlas brjod shub bur bzla ba'am/ ma grub na'ang khro mo'i bskyed rim gyi nga rgyal brtan par byas nas/ nyes pas mi gos pa ni myong bas grub pa yin no/ /bzlas pa'i mthar 'og gtor 'bul gyi rjes nas byung ba'i 'dod gsol de bya/ gsum pa ni/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'chang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud yongs su gang ba'i nang du skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs pa nas/ sku can du gyur pa bdag bskyed bzhin/ 'di la gnas gsum byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren stim dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams ma bshad pas/ dam ye dbyer med du bskyed pa la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ utstshuṣma kro dhī arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhāḥ de bzhin du pā dyaṃ nas/ shapta'i mthar dharmā ra ṇi dril gsil rol chen/

bstod pa ni/ gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas kyang / /mi gtsang dri ma kun sel zhing / /gtsang bdag bde la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo la phyag 'tshal/ /sol ba ltar nag 'gyur med sku/ /nyes skyon kun gyis mi tshugs shing / /gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /mi gtsang kun sel la phyag 'tshal/ /ro gcig zhal dang dus gsum spyan/ /thabs shes phyag dang gzung 'dzin gyi/ /rnam rtog gnon pa'i zhabs gnyis ma/ /rtag chad mtha' gnon la phyag 'tshal/ /dri med rin chen las grub cing / /dag byed bdud rtsis yongs gang ba'i/ /bum gnyis phyag mtshan thugs kar bsnol/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug la phyag 'tshal/ /de las byung ba'i bdud rtsi yis/ /skal ldan 'gro ba'i sgo gsum sdig /nyams grib mi gtsang kun 'khrud pa'i/ /khrus kyi lha mo la phyag 'tshal/ /rtog pa kun las nges grol bas/ /gos rgyan spangs pa gcer mo'i sku/ /bdag med rtogs pas dbu skra sil/ /rnam par dag ma la phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i skyon bral padma'i steng / /thugs rje'i 'od gsal nyi ma'i gdan/ dgos pa kun gyi rang bzhin la/ /mnyam bzhengs mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi mthu chen rig sngags ni/ /bzlas brjod nyung ngu bgyis pas kyang / /mi gtsang dri ma kun sel zhing / /yang dag bde stsol la phyag 'tshal/ /mtha' bral chos dbyings ye shes thugs/ /stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gis/ /nyam thag 'gro la rab brtse ma/ /bde stong zung 'jug la phyag 'tshal/ /de sogs dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /yon tan phrin las kun gyi bdag /mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo sme brtsegs ma/ /bstod pa'i dge des don kun stsol/ /snyigs dus gnas grogs yo byad sogs/ /mi gtsang kho na shas che bas/ /sa lam sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen grib/ /de kun nye bar zhi bar mdzod/ /khyad par bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bslab pa dang / /'gal ba'i nyes kun byang bar mdzod/

/rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs 'gal dang / /dam tshig nyams pa'i slob ma dang / /spyod yul gcig dang gsang sgrogs sogs/ /ltung ba 'byung kun dag par mdzod/ /bskyed rdzogs g.yel zhing bzlas pa nyung / /lta ba ma bskyangs spyod pa rtsing / /mi shes ma gus bag med kyis/ /nyes pa ci mchis zhi bar mdzod/ /mthu ldan chos skyong srung kun la/ /bsgom sgrub mchod gtor chag pa dang / /'bags btsog thugs 'gal bgyis pa sogs/ /nongs pa ci mchis sel bar mdzod/ /mched lcam rdo rje spun grogs la/ /ma dad ma gus bgyis pa dang / /log par bltas pa'i las sgrib kun/ /khyed kyi thugs rjes byang bar mdzod/ /mdor na bla ma dkon mchog nas/ /sems can phra mo yan chad la/ /brten pa'i las sgrib ci bsags pa/ /de kun byang zhing dag par mdzod/ /de ltar sdig sgrib nyer dag nas/ /'di dang skye ba thams cad du/ /dal 'byor lus thob dbang po gsal/ /nad med tshe ring dpal 'byor mdzod/ /yang dag bla mas rjes bzung nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal ba dang / /mdo sngags rigs gnas shes bya'i tshogs/ /yon tan kun la bdag mkhas mdzod/ /bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin zab mo yi/ /yang dag ye shes skye ba dang / /las bzhi'i phrin las gang bsam kun/ /'gro don thogs med 'byung bar mdzod/ /bdag ni mthong thos dran pa dang / /reg pa tsam gyis 'gro ba kun/ /nyams grib sdig pa kun sel ba/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo khyed ltar mdzod/ /mdor na bdag gis bstan 'gro la/ /lhag bsam rnam dag bgyis pa kun/ /bar chad med pa mthar phyin nas/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor kun 'grub shog /gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mam lngas phul/

mtshan sngags sbyar ba'i mchod pa gong bzhin dang / bstod pa gang gi mtshan tsam ma shlau ka gcig bcom ldan 'das ma khro bo'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib nyams grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad zhi ba dang / myur du khro bo'i rgyal mo sme ba brtsegs ma'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gzungs thag bzung ste/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la zhon te song ba bum nang gi lha la phog pas de'i sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur/ zhes dang / bdag bskyed du bshad pa'i sngags de dang / oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe/ baṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ raṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ e baṃ raṃ shuddhe shuddhe/ āḥ.āḥ.āḥswāhā/ zhes sngags gnyis po 'di brgya stong la sogs pa ci nus bzlas la mchod bstod 'dod gsol gong ltar dang / yig brgya lan gsum bya/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsir gyur/ zhes brjod cing gzungs thag bsdu'o/ /gsum pa rjes ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sme ba brtsegs ma 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs bsngo smon ci shes dang / ston mchog dam pa sogs kyi bkra shis bya'o/ ༈ /byabs khrus byed na lha sngags bsgyur ba ma gtogs rnam 'joms bzhin no/ ༈ /'di'i rjes gnang bya tshul gyi shom tshom bu gcig spyi dang 'dra/ zlum gtor chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon 'gro'i bdag bskyed gong bzhin/ tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ skad cig gis lha mor bskyed/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams gong bzhin dang / bzlas pa bya/ sems bskyed zlum gtor chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ gsal 'debs sogs spyi 'gre/ slob mas maṇḍal/

dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /sogs kyis gsol gdab/ bsdu na slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la sogs gzhi dgod pa dang / ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gsung gi rjes gnang la thugs ka'i nyi dkyil sngags phreng las gnyis pa mched nas slob ma'i khar gzhug par bya dam bca'/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung mdzad/ gzhan spyi 'gre/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ ḍā ki seng ge'i gdong pa can/ gru spang rtse ba rdo rje seng ge chos rje brag nag pa/ byang sems chen po/ bla ma dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams dar/ be phug pa bde legs rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ de sras chos skyong bsod nams bkra shis/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ dpal gnas gsar ba chen po 'jam mgon bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros la stsal ba'o/ /yang na mkhyen brtse/ byams pa skal bzang / rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan man 'dra'o/ /zhes mkha' 'gro ma sme ba brtsegs ma'i chos skor bum chog sogs nyer mkho cha tshang 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos 'di'i sgrub thabs gnas gsar 'jam mgon mkhyen brtses mdzad pa dang / jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i sme ba brtsegs ljang nag gi bum chog thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa gnyis gung bsgrigs/ rjes gnang mdzad byang med pa 'di thog nas phyag len la gnang srol yod pas de yang rjes 'brel la 'thud/ bstod pa 'dod gsol bcas dang mtshams sbyor ci dgos nged rang nas gsar rtsom bgyis te 'gro phan kho na'i bsam pas sbyar ba 'di'i dge bas sems can thams cad nyams grib mi gtsang ba'i 'dam las thar nas yang dag pa'i dpal la spyod par gyur cig/
